headline: FOAM V — the wake wakes up
lede: Tidal Rush's trail stops painting and starts breaking: shaded foam lines that spread, cool and glitter as they die — and the dark stain the wake threw beside itself is gone for good, by law.

notes.text: The wake ribbon went from two flat additive lanes to five shaded ones: bright crest lines at the V arms, shoulders falling inward, a quiet channel between. Brightness rides speed and boost, crests cool white→cyan with age, and a deterministic twinkle keeps the trail alive along its whole length.

Additive-only law: the darkening strip that stained the bay beside the trail is replaced by a faint additive glow — the wake can now only ever add light to the water. Pinned in tidalcheck (196/196) with two new mutants, foamflat and glowdark, that both get caught.

The ladder kept turning: the warden's Skyward target was held by the other slot, so this lane took the never-dry pick from the whole shelf — and the first foam-V cut got judged in the browser and re-cut before shipping.
